references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, a log measure of oil is mentioned as part of the cleansing offering for the leper.
The next verse describes what the priest does with the oil in his left hand—dips his finger and sprinkles it.
A parallel description of the same ritual for the poor who cannot afford the full offering, where the priest also pours oil into his left hand.
Anointing oil is used in consecration rituals, here for Aaron and his sons as priests.
Moses pours anointing oil on Aaron's head during the priestly ordination ceremony, showing the holy significance of oil in rituals.
